## Generating synthetic datasets for projection pursuit

The preceding noise-sensitivity experiment added Gaussian measurement noise directly to a two-dimensional pattern. This experiment does not add measurement noise to the structure. Instead, it embeds a clean nonlinear structure into a higher-dimensional dataset by rotating each signal coordinate with an independent Gaussian nuisance coordinate. We study whether the original pattern remains visible in the *observed coordinate pairs* as the rotation angle changes, how their Stringy05 values change, and whether the known inverse rotation recovers the initial pattern and its index value.

Four patterns are considered: **cubic, quartic, sine, and two moons**. Each dataset has `n = 500` observations and `p = 10` variables: four potentially signal-bearing mixed coordinates and six additional independent Gaussian nuisance variables. We investigate $\theta=0,\pi/12,\pi/6,\pi/4$, corresponding to **0°, 15°, 30°, and 45°**. The same random seed is used within each pattern, so changing the angle does not change the underlying structure or nuisance draws.


## Data generator and experimental settings

### Data-generation mechanism

For the cubic, quartic, and sine examples, draw $t\sim N(0,1)$ and set the first signal coordinate to $t$. The second signal coordinate is, respectively, the third or fourth orthogonal-polynomial basis vector produced by R's `poly()` function, or $\sin(\pi t)$. In particular, `poly(t, degree = 3)[, 3]` is *not* the same as the raw function $t^3$. For two moons, points are generated on two semicircular arcs.

Each signal coordinate is standardized using its **sample** mean and sample standard deviation:

$$
\widetilde{s}_j = \frac{s_j-\overline{s}_j}{\operatorname{sd}(s_j)},
\qquad j=1,2.
$$

Consequently, the two signal coordinates have sample SD exactly 1. Generate independent nuisance coordinates $n_1,n_2\sim N(0,1)$, which have SD 1.

The signal and nuisance coordinates are mixed by an orthogonal rotation:

$$
\begin{aligned}
x_1 &= \cos(\theta)s_1+\sin(\theta)n_1, &
x_3 &= -\sin(\theta)s_1+\cos(\theta)n_1,\\
x_2 &= \cos(\theta)s_2+\sin(\theta)n_2, &
x_4 &= -\sin(\theta)s_2+\cos(\theta)n_2.
\end{aligned}
$$

Six additional nuisance variables $x_5,\ldots,x_{10}\sim N(0,1)$ are generated independently. With independent signal and nuisance coordinates, the rotated variables have approximately unit sample variance.

### Reproducible setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(cassowaryr)

gen_hidden_stringy_components <- function(
    n = 500, p = 10, pattern = "cubic",
    theta = pi / 4, seed = 918
) {
  pattern <- match.arg(pattern, c("cubic", "quartic", "sine", "two_moons"))
  stopifnot(n >= 5, p >= 4)
  set.seed(seed)

  if (pattern == "two_moons") {
    group <- sample(rep(1:2, length.out = n))
    angle <- runif(n, 0, pi)
    s1 <- ifelse(group == 1, cos(angle), 1 - cos(angle))
    s2 <- ifelse(group == 1, sin(angle), 0.5 - sin(angle))
  } else {
    t <- rnorm(n)
    s1 <- t
    s2 <- switch(
      pattern,
      cubic = poly(t, degree = 3)[, 3],
      quartic = poly(t, degree = 4)[, 4],
      sine = sin(pi * t)
    )
  }


  s1 <- as.numeric(scale(s1))
  s2 <- as.numeric(scale(s2))

  n1 <- rnorm(n, sd = 1)
  n2 <- rnorm(n, sd = 1)

  x1 <-  cos(theta) * s1 + sin(theta) * n1
  x3 <- -sin(theta) * s1 + cos(theta) * n1
  x2 <-  cos(theta) * s2 + sin(theta) * n2
  x4 <- -sin(theta) * s2 + cos(theta) * n2

  observed <- tibble(x1 = x1, x2 = x2, x3 = x3, x4 = x4)
  if (p > 4) {
    extra_noise <- matrix(rnorm(n * (p - 4), sd = 1), nrow = n)
    colnames(extra_noise) <- paste0("x", 5:p)
    observed <- bind_cols(observed, as_tibble(extra_noise))
  }

  list(
    observed = observed,
    original = tibble(s1 = s1, s2 = s2)
  )
}

gen_hidden_stringy <- function(n = 500, p = 10, pattern = "cubic",
                              theta = pi / 4, seed = 918) {
  gen_hidden_stringy_components(n, p, pattern, theta, seed)$observed
}

n <- 500
p <- 10
seed <- 918
patterns <- c("cubic", "quartic", "sine", "two_moons")
angles <- tibble(
  angle = c(0, pi / 12, pi / 6, pi / 4),
  angle_label = factor(
    c("0°", "15°", "30°", "45°"),
    levels = c("0°", "15°", "30°", "45°")
  )
)

experiments <- tidyr::crossing(
  pattern = factor(patterns, levels = patterns),
  angles
) |>
  mutate(result = purrr::map2(
    as.character(pattern), angle,
    ~ gen_hidden_stringy_components(
      n = n, p = p, pattern = .x, theta = .y, seed = seed
    )
  ))
```


## Original clean geometric structures

The raw structural coordinates are standardized before rotation. The plots below therefore show the original clean patterns, without mixing with nuisance variables.

```{r}
original_patterns <- experiments |>
  filter(angle == 0) |>
  mutate(original = map(result, "original")) |>
  select(pattern, original) |>
  unnest(original)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-original-patterns
#| fig-cap: "Original clean, standardized two-dimensional geometric patterns before rotation."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
ggplot(original_patterns, aes(s1, s2)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.65, alpha = 0.7, colour = "#2679A8") +
  facet_wrap(~ pattern, ncol = 2, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Original signal s1", y = "Original signal s2") +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
```

## Original and mixed views

The observed-coordinate views among the four mixed variables are all six combinations:

$$
(x_1,x_2),\ (x_1,x_3),\ (x_1,x_4),\ (x_2,x_3),\ (x_2,x_4),\ (x_3,x_4).
$$

```{r}
#| label: prepare-views

observed_pairs <- combn(paste0("x", 1:4), 2, simplify = FALSE)

make_views <- function(result, theta) {
  x <- result$observed
  original <- result$original

  mixed <- purrr::map_dfr(observed_pairs, function(vars) {
    tibble(
      u = x[[vars[1]]],
      v = x[[vars[2]]],
      view = paste(vars, collapse = "–"),
      type = "Mixed pair"
    )
  })

  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      u = original$s1,
      v = original$s2,
      view = "Original s1–s2",
      type = "Original"
    ),
    mixed
  )
}

view_data <- experiments |>
  mutate(views = map2(result, angle, make_views)) |>
  select(pattern, angle, angle_label, views) |>
  unnest(views) |>
  mutate(
    view = factor(
      view,
      levels = c(
        "Original s1–s2",
        vapply(
          observed_pairs,
          paste,
          character(1),
          collapse = "–"
        )
      )
    )
  )

```

### Plot original and mixed views

Each figure shows one pattern, with rotation angles in rows and the original structure plus six mixed pairs in columns.

```{r}

#| label: fig-mixed-views
#| fig-cap: "Original structure and all six mixed coordinate pairs across rotation angles (one figure per pattern)."
#| fig-width: 17
#| fig-height: 10
#| results: asis

for (pat in patterns) {

  cat("\n\n### Pattern: ", pat, "\n\n", sep = "")

  fig <- view_data |>
    filter(as.character(pattern) == pat) |>
    ggplot(aes(u, v)) +
    geom_point(
      size = 0.35,
      alpha = 0.55,
      colour = "#2679A8"
    ) +
    facet_grid(
      angle_label ~ view,
      scales = "free"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Structure visibility across rotation angles:",
        pat
      )) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
          axis.title = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.7, "lines")
    )

  print(fig)
}

```

## Calculate `Stringy05` index values

We calculate `Stringy05` for the original structure and each of the six mixed coordinate pairs.

```{r}

#| label: score-views
rescale_scores <- TRUE

score_stringy05 <- function(x, y, rescale = rescale_scores) {
  as.numeric(
    cassowaryr::sc_stringy05(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      rescale = rescale
    )
  )
}

index_scores <- view_data |>
  group_by(pattern, angle, angle_label, view, type) |>
  summarise(
    value = score_stringy05(u, v),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(all(is.finite(index_scores$value)))

```

### Numerical scores for every view

```{r}

#| label: tbl-all-index-values
#| tbl-cap: "Rescaled Stringy05 values for original structures and all six mixed coordinate pairs across patterns and rotation angles."

index_scores |>
  select(pattern, angle_label, view, value) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = view,
    values_from = value
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 4)

```


Let's investigate smaller rotation angles between 0° and 15° to determine how quickly Stringy05 decreases when the original structure is mixed with Gaussian nuisance variables.



```{r}
#| label: prepare-small-angles

small_angles <- c(0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 12, 14)

experiments_small <- tidyr::crossing(
  pattern = patterns,
  angle = small_angles
) |>
  mutate(
    theta = angle * pi / 180,
    angle_label = factor(
      paste0(angle, "°"),
      levels = paste0(small_angles, "°")
    ),
    result = purrr::map2(
      pattern,
      theta,
      \(p, th) {

        # Use the same generator as in the original experiment
        x <- gen_hidden_stringy(
          n = 500,
          p = 10,
          pattern = p,
          theta = th,
          seed = 918
        )

        # Recover the original standardized coordinates
        # to construct the reference original view
        original <- tibble(
          s1 = cos(th) * x$x1 - sin(th) * x$x3,
          s2 = cos(th) * x$x2 - sin(th) * x$x4
        )

        list(
          observed = x,
          original = original
        )
      }
    )
  )

view_data_small <- experiments_small |>
  mutate(
    views = map2(result, angle, make_views)
  ) |>
  select(pattern, angle, angle_label, views) |>
  unnest(views) |>
  mutate(
    view = factor(
      view,
      levels = c(
        "Original s1–s2",
        vapply(
          observed_pairs,
          paste,
          character(1),
          collapse = "–"
        )
      )
    )
  )
```



```{r}
#| label: fig-small-angle-views
#| fig-cap: "Original structure and six mixed coordinate pairs for rotation angles below 15 degrees."
#| fig-width: 17
#| fig-height: 16
#| results: asis

for (pat in patterns) {

  cat("\n\n### Pattern: ", pat, "\n\n", sep = "")

  fig <- view_data_small |>
    filter(as.character(pattern) == pat) |>
    ggplot(aes(u, v)) +
    geom_point(
      size = 0.35,
      alpha = 0.55,
      colour = "#2679A8"
    ) +
    facet_grid(
      angle_label ~ view,
      scales = "free"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Structure visibility at small rotation angles:",
        pat
      )
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.7, "lines")
    )

  print(fig)
}
```


```{r}
#| label: score-small-angle-views

index_scores_small <- view_data_small |>
  group_by(pattern, angle, angle_label, view, type) |>
  summarise(
    value = score_stringy05(u, v),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(all(is.finite(index_scores_small$value)))
```

## 4. Table of Stringy05 scores

```{r}
#| label: tbl-small-angle-index-values
#| tbl-cap: "Rescaled Stringy05 for the original structures and mixed coordinate pairs at rotation angles below 15 degrees."

index_scores_small |>
  select(pattern, angle_label, view, value) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = view,
    values_from = value
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 4)
```



```{r}
#| label: fig-stringy-small-angle
#| fig-cap: "Change in rescaled Stringy05 for the original structure and x1–x2 as the rotation angle increases."
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 7

index_scores_small |>
  filter(
    as.character(view) %in%
      c("Original s1–s2", "x1–x2")
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = angle,
      y = value,
      colour = view,
      group = view
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ pattern, ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = small_angles) +
  labs(
    x = "Rotation angle (degrees)",
    y = "Stringy05",
    colour = "View"
  ) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
```



```{r}
#| label: tbl-best-small-angle-pairs
#| tbl-cap: "Highest-scoring mixed variable pair at each rotation angle."

best_pairs_small <- index_scores_small |>
  filter(type == "Mixed pair") |>
  group_by(pattern, angle) |>
  slice_max(
    order_by = value,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  ungroup()

best_pairs_small |>
  select(
    pattern,
    angle,
    best_pair = view,
    best_stringy05 = value
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 4)
```
